verdict.reason: Both test sets provide target answers and local evidence subgraphs, but no gold logical form or executable query. Converting an unconstrained generated question back into a query would require a new semantic parser whose accuracy is not validated in this repository. Its execution score would therefore confound question preservation with parser errors.
verdict.safe_evidence_used_instead: Report decomposed operator, answer-slot, comparator/reference, leakage, and overall faithfulness judgments, with matched-ID paired confidence intervals.
